scope: Owner-approved two-track development, existing scope and gates

tracks.objective: Implement native durable execution attempts on the accepted queued/cancelled intake queue, with lease/revision fences, validated reconstruction and bounded retry/result recovery.
contract: Existing source bytes, source revision, current company membership and capability are verified before claim and settlement.
A transaction persists an execution claim/attempt and append-only lifecycle/outbox evidence before any configured internal transport starts.
Existing immutable migration bytes and checksum pins stay unchanged; only new durable-job-execution.review.sql may extend installed schema with separately verified history and structural guards.

Lease expiry fences results but never proves physical transport closure or frees capacity; restart/unknown transport remains held until trusted stop/closure proof. No caller-provided boolean alone may release physical capacity.
Duplicate delivery and stale or cancelled completions commit at most one review-required result, never a posting/financial effect.
Rehydrate stored execution/result via existing validators, not type casts, and reject gaps, mismatches or forged evidence.
OCR/email/provider connectivity remains not_connected; no startup/upload automatic enqueue, scheduler, live provider connection or production migration.
acceptance: Native queued to claimed to review-required or bounded-failure result is durable and recoverable.
Concurrent claims, stale completions, cancellation/revocation/source mutation, retry limits and unknown closure are covered.
Actual process death/fresh process recovery and populated restore are exercised by the existing disposable CI runner.
Parent stays pending for unimplemented scheduler, fenced delivery, provider controls or other original acceptance.
tracks.budget: Bounded implementation; root independent review and combined CI afterwards

tracks.objective: Complete the supported-case inventory against all existing tax/payroll source bullets and close the register prerequisite if evidence supports it, without qualifying engines.
contract: Cover regional/residency, multiple-business/income interactions, company frameworks/supplements and VAT exceptions, using pinned authoritative provenance and concrete required input/output examples.
Retain every promised payroll/tax/VAT scope and all existing official reference packs.
Distinguish scope-register completeness from P04-03 expected-result qualification and P04-02 calculation implementation.
Unknown and unqualified cases fail explicitly; no supported-engine promotion or production adapter.
Tests independently enumerate backlog coverage and reject removed, duplicate, contradictory and unknown variant cases.
acceptance: Machine-readable full scope register maps each promised family/variant to source task, owner, official provenance, required input/output examples and acceptance tests.
All original P04-01 criteria reviewed without deleting remaining engine qualification gaps.
P04-03 and P02-04 readiness reassessed after full register acceptance, with a concrete next implementation or verification task.

boundaries: No raw tokens or credentials in reports
No merges, deployments, production changes or external sends
One coordinator; independent author review; at most two implementation tracks
